title: RC Scale USS YORKTOWN CV-5
author: MDSW
status: Converted and integrated into shipyard and formation previews; aircraft combat not implemented
modifications: Original download preserved. Complete STL normalized to game scale, position-cell vertex clustering applied, collapsed/duplicate faces removed, normals regenerated and materials recolored. No battleship turrets added. See conversion.json and LICENSE.txt.
accuracy: Printable CV-5 model, not the later CV-10. Runtime mesh is reduced from 4,537,586 triangles. Upstream attribution still requires review.
